Girya's Strength is therefore in place before any of that. The sim's on_combat_start is dispatched once, in listener-registration order (= the order relics sit in run.relics), so a relic registered before Girya sees Strength 0 where C# would show it 3. DORMANT: an executed grep of the sim's on_combat_start bodies for Strength readers finds only WRITERS -- relics/ember_tea.py:33, philosophers_stone.py:32/37, sling_of_courage.py:27, sword_of_jade.py:24 all APPLY Strength and none reads the total -- and addition is commutative, so no ordering changes the final amount. Porting any combat-start effect that READS player Strength -- a scaling block grant, or a monster intent whose damage preview is computed at creature-add time -- makes it live.
